In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 4

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))
```

# Read Data

```{r}
tcrs <- read_csv("data/tcr/filtered_contigs_paired_241120.csv")
tcrs
```

```{r}
seuobj.tnkilc <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_tnkilc_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj.tnkilc
```

```{r}
seuobj.tnkilc <- AddMetaData(seuobj.tnkilc, tcrs %>% column_to_rownames("barcode"))
seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data
```

# Differential Expression

```{r}
de.ccduc.thelper.df <- read_csv("out/deseq2/DE__UCvscCD_Thelper.csv")
de.ccduc.thelper.df
```

```{r}
de.ccduc.thelper.range <- de.ccduc.thelper.df$log2FoldChange %>% range %>% abs %>% max %>% ceiling
de.ccduc.thelper.range <- c(-de.ccduc.thelper.range, de.ccduc.thelper.range)
de.ccduc.thelper.range
```


```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
ggplot(de.ccduc.thelper.df %>% 
         mutate(labelname = ifelse(padj <= 0.01 | (padj <= 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1), gene, NA)) %>% 
         mutate(diagSub = ifelse(sign(stat) == 1, "UC", "cCD")) %>% 
         mutate(pointfill = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, diagSub, "Not DE")) %>% 
         mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("cCD", "UC"))), 
       aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), label = labelname)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, lty = 2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, lty = 2) +  
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", aes(fill = pointfill)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(color = pointfill, size = -log10(padj)), seed = thisseed,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 2) +
  geom_label_repel(color = "black", seed = thisseed, aes(size = -log10(padj)),
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec, limits = c("cCD", "UC")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(diagSubColVec, "Not DE" = "gray50"), limits = c("cCD", "Not DE", "UC"), 
                    labels = c("cCD" = "Enriched in cCD", 
                               "Not DE" = "Not DE", 
                               "UC" = "Enriched in UC")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2,6)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = de.ccduc.thelper.range) +
  facet_wrap(~annotation, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    size = "Percent Expression",
    x = "Average Log2 FC",
    y = "-Log10 P Value (Adjusted)"
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", color="black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color="black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  ) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 8)))
```

# Gene Expression

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
plot.a <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>%  droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj.tnkilc",
  features = c("TOX", "HAVCR2", "TNFRSF4"),
  relative.to = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th1", "Th17"),
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, cellstate, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(.,
         aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5, seed = thisseed)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5)) +
  facet_grid(featureVar~cellstate, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("cCD", "UC")), label = "p.format", vjust = 1.4, size = 5, tip.length = 0.05, bracket.size = 1) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "Mean Gene Expression",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )
```

```{r}
th17.barcodes <- seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB) & timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & cellstate == "Th17") %>% 
  rownames

th17.barcodes %>% length
```

```{r}
seuobj.th17 <- subset(seuobj.tnkilc, cells = th17.barcodes)
seuobj.th17
```

```{r}
seuobj.th17 <- FindNeighbors(seuobj.th17, reduction = "X_scVI", dims = 1:30, k.param = 20)
seuobj.th17 <- RunUMAP(object = seuobj.th17, reduction = "X_scVI", dims = 1:30, n.neighbors = 20, min.dist = 0.3, spread = 1)
```

# Clonal Overlap

## UMAPs

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
seuobj.tnkilc$cellstate.plot <- ifelse(seuobj.tnkilc$cellstate %in% c("Th1", "Th17", "Prlf. Teff"),
                                       as.character(seuobj.tnkilc$cellstate), "Other CD4T") %>% 
  fct_relevel(., c("Th1", "Th17", "Prlf. Teff", "Other CD4T"))
DimPlot(seuobj.tnkilc, cells = seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data %>% 
          rownames_to_column("barcode") %>% 
          filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & tgroup == "CD4T") %>% 
          pull(barcode), raster = T, 
        group.by = "cellstate.plot", 
        cols = c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")[c(2,4,12)], "gray90")) + ggtitle(label = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(5.5,13), ylim = c(1,7.5)) +
  labs(
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    title = "CD4 T Cell States"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = c(0, 0.125), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA)
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
```

```{r}
shared.prlf.ccd.fisher <- shared.prlf.th.df %>% 
  filter(diagSub == "cCD") %>% 
  pivot_longer(ends_with("Overlap"), 
               names_to = "Overlap_CellState", 
               names_transform =  ~str_remove(., pattern = "_Overlap"),
               values_to = "Clonal_Overlap"
  ) %>% 
  select(Overlap_CellState, Clonal_Overlap) %>% 
  droplevels %>% 
  table

shared.prlf.ccd.fisher

shared.prlf.ccd.fisher[c(1,2),] %>% fisher.test
shared.prlf.ccd.fisher[c(2,1),] %>% fisher.test
```

```{r}
shared.prlf.uc.fisher <- shared.prlf.th.df %>% 
  filter(diagSub == "UC") %>% 
  pivot_longer(ends_with("Overlap"), 
               names_to = "Overlap_CellState", 
               names_transform =  ~str_remove(., pattern = "_Overlap"),
               values_to = "Clonal_Overlap"
  ) %>% 
  select(Overlap_CellState, Clonal_Overlap) %>% 
  droplevels %>% 
  table

shared.prlf.uc.fisher

shared.prlf.uc.fisher[c(1,2),] %>% fisher.test
shared.prlf.uc.fisher[c(2,1),] %>% fisher.test
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
th1th17.prlf.annotation <- data.frame(
  diagSub = c("cCD", "UC"),
  label = c(
    paste("p =", signif(shared.prlf.ccd.fisher %>% fisher.test %>% .$p.value,2)), 
    paste("p =", signif(shared.prlf.uc.fisher %>% fisher.test %>% .$p.value,2))
  ),
  x     = c(1.5, 1.5),
  y     = c(0.225, 0.225)
)
th1th17.prlf.annotation

shared.prlf.th.df %>% 
  group_by(diagSub) %>% 
  mutate(n_shared.th1 = sum(Th1_Overlap)) %>% 
  mutate(n_unshared.th1 = sum(!Th1_Overlap)) %>% 
  mutate(prop.th1 = n_shared.th1/(n_shared.th1+n_unshared.th1)) %>% 
  mutate(shared.label.th1 = paste0(n_shared.th1, "/", n_shared.th1+n_unshared.th1)) %>% 
  mutate(n_shared.th17 = sum(Th17_Overlap)) %>% 
  mutate(n_unshared.th17 = sum(!Th17_Overlap)) %>% 
  mutate(prop.th17 = n_shared.th17/(n_shared.th17+n_unshared.th17)) %>% 
  mutate(shared.label.th17 = paste0(n_shared.th17, "/", n_shared.th17+n_unshared.th17)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  distinct(diagSub, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  select(diagSub, ends_with(c(".th1", ".th17"))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prop.th1, prop.th17), names_to = "cellstate", values_to = "prop") %>% 
  mutate(cellstate = case_when(
    cellstate == "prop.th1" ~ "Th1",
    cellstate == "prop.th17" ~ "Th17"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(shared.label = case_when(
    cellstate == "Th1" ~ paste0(n_shared.th1, "/", n_shared.th1+n_unshared.th1),
    cellstate == "Th17" ~ paste0(n_shared.th17, "/", n_shared.th17+n_unshared.th17),
  )) %>% 
  # mutate(facetName = "Th17 and Prlf. Teff") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cellstate, y = prop, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_col(color = "black", lwd = 1) + 
  geom_text(aes(y = prop, label = shared.label), color = "black",
            size = 6, fontface = "bold", vjust = -.2) +
  geom_text(data = th1th17.prlf.annotation, mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), size = 6) +
  facet_grid(~diagSub) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(0,1,0.05), limits = c(0,0.225)) +
  labs(
    fill = NULL,
    y = "% of Prlf. Teff Cells\nwith Clonal Overlap",
  ) +
  theme_light() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black")
  )
```

```{r}
cd4t.df <- seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data %>% 
  rownames_to_column("barcode") %>% 
  filter(tgroup == "CD4T" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & timepoint == "T0" & !is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  select(barcode, cellstate, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint) %>% 
  left_join(., umap.tnkilc, by = "barcode") %>% 
  arrange(cellstate)

cd4t.df
```

```{r}
shared.th1.network <- read_csv("out/tcr/clonaloverlap/ccduc_th1prlfteff_network.csv")
shared.th1.network

shared.th17.network <- read_csv("out/tcr/clonaloverlap/ccduc_th17prlfteff_network.csv")
shared.th17.network
```



```{r}
list.prlf.th1.th1 <- shared.th1.network$barcode_Th1 %>% str_split("___")
list.prlf.th1.prlf <- shared.th1.network$`barcode_Prlf. Teff` %>% str_split("___")
vec.prlf.th1.diagSub <- shared.th1.network$diagSub
edges.prlf.th1 <- data.frame()
for (x in 1:nrow(shared.th1.network)){
  edges.prlf.th1 <- rbind(edges.prlf.th1, expand.grid(
    list.prlf.th1.th1[[x]], 
    list.prlf.th1.prlf[[x]], 
    vec.prlf.th1.diagSub[[x]]))
}

edges.prlf.th1 <- edges.prlf.th1 %>% 
  rowwise %>% 
  mutate(from = which((cd4t.df %>% pull(barcode)) == Var1)) %>% 
  mutate(to = which((cd4t.df  %>% pull(barcode))  == Var2)) %>% 
  ungroup
  
edges.prlf.th1

nodes.prlf.th1 <- cd4t.df %>% 
  mutate(connected = ifelse(barcode %in% c(edges.prlf.th1$Var1, edges.prlf.th1$Var2), "Connected", "Solo"))

nodes.prlf.th1

ggraph.prlf.th1 <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes.prlf.th1, edges = edges.prlf.th1, directed = T) %>% arrange(desc(connected))
ggraph.prlf.th1
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
ggraph(ggraph.prlf.th1, 
       layout = (ggraph.prlf.th1 %>%  igraph::get.data.frame("vertices") %>% 
                   select(X_umap1,X_umap2) %>% 
                   dplyr::rename(x = X_umap1, y = X_umap2))) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = connected, size = connected, fill = ifelse(connected == "Connected", as.character(diagSub), "Solo")), shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(diagSubColVec, "Solo" = "gray90")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Connected" = "black", "Solo" = "gray90")) + 
  scale_size_manual(values = c("Connected" = 1.25, "Solo" = 0.01)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Connected" = 1, "Solo" = 0.01)) +
  geom_edge_hive(aes(color = Var3), edge_width = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(5.5,13), ylim = c(1,7.5)) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  guides(color = "none", size = "none", fill = "none",
         edge_color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(edge_width = 5, edge_alpha = 1))) +
  # geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "UMAP1",
    y = "UMAP2",
    title = "Th1 and Prlf. Teff Clonal Overlap",
    edge_color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.1,0.1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```
